➤Webster\"s Revised Unabridged Dictionary
( n. )
A circle of light; especially, the bright ring represented in painting as surrounding the heads of saints and other holy persons; a glory; a nimbus.

( n. )
A colored circle around a nipple; an areola.

( n. )
A luminous circle

( n. )
An ideal glory investing, or affecting one\"s perception of, an object.

( v. t. & i. )
To form, or surround with, a halo; to encircle with, or as with, a halo.
➤English Etymology
1563, from L. halo (acc.), from Gk. halos "disk of the sun or moon, ring of light around the sun or moon" (also "threshing floor" and "disk of a shield"), of unknown origin. Sense of "light around the head of a holy person or deity" first recorded 1646.
subject: English Language and Literature

Preposition "on" এর


কিছু সাধারণ ব্যবহার:

কোনো কিছুর উপরে:
The book is on the table. (বইটি টেবিলের উপর রয়েছে।)

She is on the bus. (সে বাসে আছে।)

কোনো বিষয় বা কারণ:
